description: A prefix-closed sequence tree has a countable path set or a path set of cardinality continuum.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.body_cardinality_dichotomy {T : Set (List ℕ)}
  (hT : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.IsSequenceTree T) :
  (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.body T).Countable ∨
    Cardinal.mk ↑(Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.body T) = Cardinal.continuum
